prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1048; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a busy road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact was firm enough to jolt me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt a sharp pain in my right knee as it hit the dashboard area. I stayed at the scene until the other driver and I exchanged details, and I have been the named driver on this policy for the entire time I have held it. Since that day I have given the same account of what happened each time I have been asked, though I have remembered a few minor details since then, such as the color of the other car's bumper and how long the traffic behind us had been waiting. Those additions do not change the sequence of events. My knee has been stiff and sore, and I have been seeing a doctor about it since the collision.
